slide1.label: AUTOMATIC TRACKING
slide1.title: Ditch the paper logbook.
slide1.body: Enter your MMSI and SeaTime Tracker picks up AIS positions automatically. Your sea service builds in the background while you focus on the job.

slide2.label: MCA-COMPLIANT REPORTS
slide2.title: CoC-ready at the tap of a button.
slide2.body: Export sea service testimonials in the format the MCA actually requires. PDF or CSV, signed and ready to submit with your next Notice of Eligibility.

slide3.label: BUILT BY MARINERS
slide3.title: By Foreland Marine.
slide3.body: We build Lightship ISM for fleet managers. SeaTime Tracker puts the same standards into the hands of individual officers and engineers.
